tasks.title: Verify candidate source objects
tasks.acceptance: Every selected repository/commit resolves; missing objects are reported, not replaced.
tasks.environment: source verification; remote or healthy workspace

tasks.title: Complete build input lock
tasks.acceptance: Recursive source/toolchain inputs, Nix lock, dirty patches and artifact identities are recorded.

tasks.title: Reproduce unmodified ARM64 VM
tasks.acceptance: Pinned PureDarwin build reaches a usable ARM64 VM prompt with reproducible logs.

tasks.title: Inventory known-good hardware setup
tasks.acceptance: Actual target board/SoC/firmware, controller revision, console paths and recovery trial are recorded.

tasks.title: Implement reviewed controller backend
tasks.acceptance: One approved known-good test runs with exclusive transport, bounded timeout, raw logs and controlled recovery.

tasks.title: Prove independent XNU entry
tasks.acceptance: Our built artifact reaches an identifiable entry/console marker; no stock-kernel substitution.

tasks.title: Bring up minimal platform/RAM root
tasks.acceptance: Timers, interrupts, memory and basic processes work without internal-storage writes.

tasks.title: Generate Asahi ABI probes
tasks.acceptance: Complete kernel and userspace definitions compared at required target ABI; mismatches recorded.

tasks.title: Inventory driver OS dependencies
tasks.acceptance: Memory, DMA, synchronization, device and Rust abstractions are enumerated with source provenance.

tasks.title: Prove graphics memory/sync substrate
tasks.acceptance: Backing lifetime, sharing, cache visibility and fences pass real tests, including failure cases.

tasks.title: Execute and verify real off-screen GPU work
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic readback validates work; failures retire/retain resources correctly.

tasks.title: Implement presentation and input
tasks.acceptance: Actual output/input integration works and survives defined failure cases.

tasks.title: Design Chonkstep platform boundary
tasks.acceptance: Existing manifests/source inspected; portable core and backend responsibilities explicitly mapped.

tasks.title: Run Chonkstep on Darwin
tasks.acceptance: Real Darwin backend displays and controls applications without Linux-only hidden dependencies.

tasks.title: Specify product interaction stories
tasks.acceptance: Gesture, overview, scaling, keyboard and recovery flows have measurable acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Establish application compatibility gates
tasks.acceptance: POSIX/toolchain/TLS/app checks recorded separately; no inferred macOS binary compatibility.
